candidate_reports.remark: Minor inundation along the Causeway over Mobile Bay noted on highway webcams. By 330am_ the right lane along the Causeway was flooded along with the eastbound ramp from the Causeway to I-10.
Broadcast media relayed public report of bad street flooding in Foley.
Several roads closed due to flooding. E Michigan Ave from Commercial Dr to Bay Str_ WB traffic at CR12 and James Rd_ and EB traffic at CR12 and Hwy-59.
Flooding on E. Beach Blvd and E 3rd Str.
Flooding reported at Tanger outlets_ with water reported up to doors aof cars at south end.
Flooded yards reported after 6.0+ inches of rain.
